verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and a console, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting. The security docs cover containerized isolation and data-center certifications, which are a different capability from telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
